variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
